title: Establish the standalone Papyrus marketing site
description:
## Intent

As a prospective Papyrus adopter, I want a standalone Papyrus marketing site at papyrus.anth.us, so that I can understand the product separately from the demo publication at p.apyr.us.

## Initial scope

- Establish a simple, normal marketing-site application separate from the Papyrus CMS reader.
- Provide a reliable local development command and foundation for static deployment.
- Reserve the existing Papyrus plant pictogram as the initial brand anchor.
- Do not add CMS, publication-reader, or wiki behavior.

## Definition of Done

- The marketing app has an executable behavior specification.
- A local dev server starts and serves the app.
- The work is ready for later visual design.
